programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: Wynona wants to collect some white flying fluff. The Woohoos discover that the white fluff comes from fluffballs, and that the fluffballs used to be dandelion flowers.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the King of Cricket
programs.desc: After Amma tells them that Thatha is the King of Cricket, Nikhil and Jay try their hardest to play cricket so they can be the Kings of Cricket too!

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: Daniel really wants to go outside and play in the snow, but it's too early in the morning. Dad Tiger shows Daniel that he's big enough now to wait in bed until it's time to get up.

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: Sock decides to make his very own space movie and gets the townsfolk to help him. But when Sock gets upset when things don't go as planned, Mittens encourages him to keep trying.

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: MeMo and BaBa have fun looking at their reflections in a puddle and with a toy mirror. The toy mirror proves very useful after a messy meal of spaghetti with the Yummies.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.desc: The Mixmups mix up a Detective adventure to try and solve a mystery. Will they be able to trace the cucumber muncher?

programs.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programs.desc: When Frieda joins Eddie's class, he feels nervous about the changes. Eddie learns to welcome her with kindness and discovers that new friends can be great fun.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: When Dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Who loves sushi? Fizzy and Suds do! Join our bubbles as they find out how to make this delicious healthy food. All aboard the sushi train!

programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: Nim's bug house inspires her to create a flapping bug pic. She also makes pumpkin jellies and crafts a log cabin, with the help of one of the Crafty Kids.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Tsehay faces gardening trouble with her sunflowers and Lachy, the gardening expert, steps in to offer advice. The Wiggles sing the 'Garden Barcarole' outside as Lachy continues sharing his gardening wisdom.

programs.title: Andy's Global Adventures
programs.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Amazon on a global adventure in search of piraputanga fish.
